body.title: WIP: Allow further customization of docker container setup
body.body:
## Description

This PR introduces some enhancements to docker root image so it eases customizing some paths and use custom provided SSH keys.

The implementation tried hard to do the minimal changes possible and to keep the previous behaviour, so respecting original settings/values.

* Replace/refactored all hard-coded paths into common variables (non-ini) FORGE_CUSTOM and FORGEJO_WORK_DIR, defaulting to GITEA_xxxx variables for compatilibity or its previous hard-coded value (/data/gitea) this eases customizing docker volume usage
* Both environment and ini settings are checked for other variables paths like SSH_SERVER_HOST_KEYS and git HOME_PATH
* Git ($USER) home directory updated accordingly
* OpenSSH honors SSH_SERVER_HOST_KEYS (or use defaults) and they are dynamically added (Fixes https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/15154#issuecomment-27542004)
* Support providing only SSH private keys by auto-extracting the public pair from them
* Custom configuration file variable FORGEJO_CUSTOM to support read-only docker configs.

I'm open to suggestions or additional items if needed.

### Testing done

The resulting image/new scripts have been tested with defaults and previous settings to confirm backward compatilibity and that changes will not affect already existing deployments/setups, so no documentation changes in that aspect.

Tested setting different FORGE_CUSTOM and FORGEJO_WORK_DIR paths, using provided docker configs and custom SSH keys

### Documentation

Added features/flexibility previous behavior not changed so current documentation is still valid and doesn't require update.

body.title: perf: skip redundant commit status count
body.body:
There are 14 call sites of the function that retrieves the latest commit status. 13 of those don't do pagination (and pass in `db.ListOptionsAll`) so retrieving all the commit statuses inherently already has the count. No need to do another COUNT query.

This saves one query per call. And this function is called quite often. For example on commit lists, releases page, PR list etc.
